sections.content: CONFIDENTIAL - FOR INTERNAL USE ONLY. This report tracks privileged user activity across all monitored database systems. Prepared for CISO / Security Operations.

sections.query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_privileged_logins, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'failed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS failed_attempts, SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(HOUR FROM last_request_end_time) < 6 OR EXTRACT(HOUR FROM last_request_end_time) >= 22 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS after_hours_access, COUNT(DISTINCT login_name) AS unique_privileged_users, COUNT(DISTINCT server) AS servers_accessed FROM monitoring.active_transactions WHERE last_request_end_time >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '30 days' AND (login_name LIKE '%%admin%%' OR login_name LIKE '%%sa%%' OR login_name LIKE '%%dba%%' OR login_name LIKE '%%root%%' OR login_name LIKE '%%postgres%%' OR login_name LIKE '%%sys%%' OR login_name LIKE '%%SYSTEM%%')
sections.template: Reporting Period: Last 30 Days. Total Privileged Logins: {total_privileged_logins}. Failed Attempts: {failed_attempts}. After-Hours Access: {after_hours_access}. Unique Privileged Users: {unique_privileged_users}. Servers Accessed: {servers_accessed}.

sections.content: Monitored systems: All production SQL Servers, PostgreSQL clusters, Oracle databases, and MySQL/MariaDB instances. Privileged accounts: DBA accounts, service accounts with elevated privileges, domain-admin linked DB accounts. Monitoring controls: Login tracking, DDL activity, privilege escalation, data export/bulk read, security configuration changes.

sections.query: SELECT login_name, server, COUNT(*) AS login_count, COUNT(DISTINCT host_name) AS source_ips, SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(HOUR FROM last_request_end_time) < 6 OR EXTRACT(HOUR FROM last_request_end_time) >= 22 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS after_hours FROM monitoring.active_transactions WHERE last_request_end_time >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '30 days' AND (login_name LIKE '%%admin%%' OR login_name LIKE '%%sa%%' OR login_name LIKE '%%dba%%' OR login_name LIKE '%%root%%' OR login_name LIKE '%%postgres%%' OR login_name LIKE '%%sys%%') GROUP BY login_name, server ORDER BY login_count DESC LIMIT 25

SELECT login_name, COUNT(*) AS after_hours_sessions FROM monitoring.active_transactions WHERE last_request_end_time >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '30 days' AND (EXTRACT(HOUR FROM last_request_end_time) < 6 OR EXTRACT(HOUR FROM last_request_end_time) >= 22) AND (login_name LIKE '%%admin%%' OR login_name LIKE '%%sa%%' OR login_name LIKE '%%dba%%' OR login_name LIKE '%%root%%' OR login_name LIKE '%%postgres%%' OR login_name LIKE '%%sys%%') GROUP BY login_name ORDER BY after_hours_sessions DESC LIMIT 10
sections.title: After-Hours Privileged Access by User (30 Days)
sections.caption: Privileged users accessing databases outside business hours (before 06:00 or after 22:00)

sections.query: SELECT gm.server, gm.metric_metadata_vs_expected::jsonb->>'row_count' AS concurrent_hosts, gm.metric_metadata_vs_expected::jsonb->>'severity' AS severity, gm.entry_date AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jerusalem' AS detected_at FROM monitoring.general_metric_metadata_results gm WHERE gm.metric_name LIKE 'SEC-SQL-ACC-010-RC10%%' AND gm.metric_metadata_vs_expected::jsonb->>'matched' = 'true' AND gm.entry_date >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '30 days' ORDER BY gm.entry_date DESC LIMIT 20

SELECT gm.server, gm.metric_metadata_vs_expected::jsonb->>'row_count' AS escalation_count, gm.metric_metadata_vs_expected::jsonb->'sample_rows'->0->>'query_text' AS sample_query, gm.metric_metadata_vs_expected::jsonb->>'severity' AS severity, gm.entry_date AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jerusalem' AS detected_at FROM monitoring.general_metric_metadata_results gm WHERE gm.metric_name LIKE 'SEC-SQL-ACC-010-RC08%%' AND gm.metric_metadata_vs_expected::jsonb->>'matched' = 'true' AND gm.entry_date >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '30 days' ORDER BY gm.entry_date DESC LIMIT 20

SELECT gm.server, gm.metric_metadata_vs_expected::jsonb->>'row_count' AS suspicious_count, gm.metric_metadata_vs_expected::jsonb->>'severity' AS severity, gm.entry_date AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jerusalem' AS detected_at FROM monitoring.general_metric_metadata_results gm WHERE gm.metric_name LIKE 'SEC-SQL-ACC-010-RC04%%' AND gm.metric_metadata_vs_expected::jsonb->>'matched' = 'true' AND gm.entry_date >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '30 days' ORDER BY gm.entry_date DESC LIMIT 20

SELECT gm.server, gm.metric_metadata_vs_expected::jsonb->>'row_count' AS exfil_events, gm.metric_metadata_vs_expected::jsonb->>'severity' AS severity, gm.entry_date AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jerusalem' AS detected_at FROM monitoring.general_metric_metadata_results gm WHERE gm.metric_name LIKE 'SEC-SQL-ACC-010-RC09%%' AND gm.metric_metadata_vs_expected::jsonb->>'matched' = 'true' AND gm.entry_date >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '30 days' ORDER BY gm.entry_date DESC LIMIT 20

SELECT gm.server, gm.metric_metadata_vs_expected::jsonb->>'row_count' AS mass_mod_events, gm.metric_metadata_vs_expected::jsonb->>'severity' AS severity, gm.entry_date AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jerusalem' AS detected_at FROM monitoring.general_metric_metadata_results gm WHERE gm.metric_name LIKE 'SEC-SQL-ACC-010-RC13%%' AND gm.metric_metadata_vs_expected::jsonb->>'matched' = 'true' AND gm.entry_date >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '30 days' ORDER BY gm.entry_date DESC LIMIT 20

SELECT gm.server, gm.metric_metadata_vs_expected::jsonb->>'row_count' AS recon_events, gm.metric_metadata_vs_expected::jsonb->>'severity' AS severity, gm.entry_date AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jerusalem' AS detected_at FROM monitoring.general_metric_metadata_results gm WHERE gm.metric_name LIKE 'SEC-SQL-ACC-010-RC11%%' AND gm.metric_metadata_vs_expected::jsonb->>'matched' = 'true' AND gm.entry_date >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '30 days' ORDER BY gm.entry_date DESC LIMIT 20

SELECT CASE WHEN metric_name LIKE '%%RC07' THEN 'After-Hours Access' WHEN metric_name LIKE '%%RC08' THEN 'Privilege Escalation' WHEN metric_name LIKE '%%RC10' THEN 'Shared Credentials' WHEN metric_name LIKE '%%RC01' THEN 'Unknown Login' WHEN metric_name LIKE '%%RC02' THEN 'Unauthorized Program' WHEN metric_name LIKE '%%RC09' THEN 'Data Exfiltration' WHEN metric_name LIKE '%%RC13' THEN 'Mass Modification' ELSE 'Other' END AS violation_type, COUNT(*) AS violation_count FROM monitoring.general_metric_metadata_results WHERE metric_name LIKE 'SEC-SQL-ACC-010%%' AND metric_metadata_vs_expected::jsonb->>'matched' = 'true' AND entry_date >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '30 days' GROUP BY violation_type ORDER BY violation_count DESC
sections.title: Policy Violations by Type (30 Days)
sections.caption: Distribution of security policy violations across all monitored servers

sections.query: SELECT DATE_TRUNC('day', entry_date) AS day, COUNT(*) AS total_findings, SUM(CASE WHEN metric_metadata_vs_expected::jsonb->>'severity' = 'critical' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS critical FROM monitoring.general_metric_metadata_results WHERE metric_name LIKE 'SEC-SQL-ACC-010%%' AND metric_metadata_vs_expected::jsonb->>'matched' = 'true' AND entry_date >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '30 days' GROUP BY day ORDER BY day
sections.title: Security Findings Trend (30 Days)
sections.caption: Daily trend of confirmed security findings across all detection categories

sections.query: WITH user_findings AS (SELECT server, jsonb_array_elements(metric_metadata_vs_expected::jsonb->'sample_rows') AS row_data, metric_metadata_vs_expected::jsonb->>'severity' AS severity FROM monitoring.general_metric_metadata_results WHERE metric_name LIKE 'SEC-SQL-ACC-010%%' AND metric_metadata_vs_expected::jsonb->>'matched' = 'true' AND entry_date >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '30 days') SELECT COALESCE(row_data->>'login_name', row_data->>'USER', 'unknown') AS login_name, server, COUNT(*) AS finding_count, MAX(severity) AS max_severity FROM user_findings WHERE row_data->>'login_name' IS NOT NULL OR row_data->>'USER' IS NOT NULL GROUP BY login_name, server ORDER BY finding_count DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT server, metric_name AS root_cause, subject, recipients, entry_date AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jerusalem' AS sent_at FROM alerts.mail_alert_log WHERE transaction_type = 'security_alert' AND entry_date >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '30 days' ORDER BY entry_date DESC LIMIT 30

sections.content:
1. [Immediate] Enforce MFA for all privileged database accounts.
2. [Immediate] Disable interactive use of shared accounts (sa, root, postgres).
3. [30 Days] Implement Just-In-Time (JIT) privilege elevation for DBA tasks.
4. [30 Days] Configure time-based access restrictions for non-service accounts.
5. [60 Days] Deploy network segmentation for database management access.
6. [Ongoing] Review and certify privileged access quarterly.

sections.query: SELECT * FROM (VALUES ('Privileged Access Monitoring', 'ISO 27001 A.8.2', 'Implemented'), ('Audit Trail', 'PCI DSS 10.1', 'Implemented'), ('Access Control Review', 'SOX Section 404', 'Implemented'), ('Failed Login Monitoring', 'NIST SP 800-53 AC-7', 'Implemented'), ('After-Hours Detection', 'ISO 27001 A.8.16', 'Implemented'), ('SQL Injection Detection', 'PCI DSS 6.5.1', 'Implemented'), ('Data Masking Verification', 'GDPR Art. 25', 'Partial'), ('Separation of Duties', 'SOX Section 404', 'Implemented')) AS t(control, framework, status)
